name: Tankbusta

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Tank Hunters
bonuses.text: This Threat gains +2 bonus dice to any Test related to the destruction of vehicles.

mobAbilities.name: Mob Rule
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Tankbustas gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Tankbustas.

note: The Tankhammer is printed as "RUIN: Tankhammer" (a weapon profile under a RUIN prefix), kept in a RUIN ability. Resilience prints "7 (AR 0)".
